Main_en.3334962773221376: Compete against other players and get rewards
Main_en.3248971962114048:
Champions Arena Overview
In Champions Arena, you compete against other players across multiple classes to climb the rankings and become the best.
Winning matches earns Medals, which determine your rank.
All players start in Bronze and progress by outperforming others.

Team Power & Win Chance
Your chance of winning depends on your Team Power compared to your opponent’s.
The higher your Team Power is against your opponent, the higher your Win Chance will be.
Your Win Chance is shown during the Arena match.

Rank & Rewards
Your rank is based on the total Medals you earn each day.
At the end of each reset, top players move up, lower-ranked players may drop down, and others stay in their current league.
Rewards are based on your final rank and sent via in-game mail.

Tickets & Reset
Each match costs 1 Arena Ticket.
Your tickets refill to 3 every day at 5:00 AM UTC.
If you have more than 3 tickets, they remain until reset.
At reset, rankings update and any extra Arena Tickets are removed, so make sure to use them before reset.
Main_en.13049565602111489:
Tournament Overview
In Tournaments, you compete in a bracket against other players in your league.
Matches are played round by round until one player becomes the champion.
Your bracket shows each matchup and when the next round will be revealed.

Rounds & Matches
Each match is played as a best-of-three. To advance in the bracket, you need to win the match.

Rewards
Rewards are based on your final tournament placement and league, and are sent via in-game mail at the end of the the bracket.

Career Mode Overview
Train your Career Driver by playing races in the assigned class. Each race gives Career XP for that class. When your Career Driver gains enough XP, they level up and earn Skill Points.

Skills
Spend Skill Points to unlock new skills. Skills can improve Offense, Defense, Income, and class-specific bonuses.

Reset Skills
You can reset your Skills at any time for Gems. Resetting refunds all spent Skill Points so you can spend them again.

Outfits
All outfits have Owned and Equipped bonuses. When you own multiple outfits, their Owned stats are combined. Each outfit can be upgraded up to 10 stars using Shards.

Weekly Tournament Overview
In Weekly Tournaments, you compete in a bracket against other players in a featured sport.
Each tournament features one sport, which rotates each week.
Your bracket shows each matchup and when the next round will be revealed.

Rounds & Matches
Each match is played as a best-of-three. To advance in the bracket, you need to win the match.

Rewards

Main_en.26437771747909637:
Club Clash Overview
In Club Clash, your Club competes against another Club to capture ranked positions and earn points over time.
Higher positions generate more Club Points, making them the most valuable spots to control.
The Club with the highest total score at the end of the event wins.

Positions & Protection
Each position can be occupied by only one player at a time.
When you capture a position, it becomes protected and cannot be challenged while the protection timer is active.
If you capture a new position, your previous position becomes empty immediately.

Challenges
You can challenge positions owned by the opposing Club.
Each player receives 3 Challenges per day.
A Challenge is used when you start a match series.

Matches
To capture an opposing position, you must win a best-of-three match series.
Each match uses a random sport.
Win at least 2 out of 3 matches to capture the position.

Empty Positions
Empty positions can be claimed immediately without playing a match.
After being claimed, the position becomes protected.

Scoring & Rewards
Occupied positions generate points for your Club over time.
Your current predicted reward is shown during the event and updates as the score changes.
At the end of Club Clash, rewards are based on whether your Club wins or loses and are sent via in-game mail.

Collections Overview
Collections are seasonal events where the main goal is to collect Cards and fill Albums. Each Album contains a set of unique Cards. Each Collection Season is available for a limited time.

Packs & Cards
Packs can be earned by playing the game. Each Pack gives Cards with different star ratings. Opening Packs helps grow the collection and complete more Albums.

Duplicate Cards
Duplicate Cards are converted into Stars. Stars can be spent in the Star Shop to get more Packs.

Wild Cards
Wild Cards can unlock missing non-Golden Cards.
Golden Wild Cards can unlock missing Golden Cards.

Rewards
Completing an Album unlocks its reward.
Completing all Albums in the season unlocks the exclusive Ultimate Reward.
